title: Commuting analytic and co-analytic Toeplitz operators on the harmonic Bergman space
summary: By constructing an appropriate quadratic form, we prove that if an analytic Toeplitz operator commutes with a co-analytic Toeplitz operator on the harmonic Bergman space, then at least one of the symbols is constant. This resolves an open question posed by Choe and Lee in 1999.
